subject: occu() function hack for "false positives" : occufp()

messages.author: 681fb59733e01a1e
messages.subject: occu() function hack for "false positives" : occufp()
parts:
Dear unmarked,

I hacked the function "occu" this morning to allow for "false positive" errors. This version does NOT allow for covariates on false positive detection probability, but rather just handles a single "constant" value of false positive detection probability.

I did limited testing but use at your own risk.

I did NOT provide any summary functions for this but plan to do so in the future. We may or may not include this function in some later release of "unmarked"

The function "occufp" is attached. Use it just like "occu"

 The reference for this type of model is as follows (don't use this function unless you read the paper -- there are "issues" with this class of models):

@article{royle2006generalized,
 title={Generalized site occupancy models allowing for false positive and false negative errors},
 author={Royle, J.A. and Link, W.A.},
 journal={Ecology},
 volume={87},
 number={4},
 pages={835--841},
 year={2006},
 publisher={Eco Soc America}
}


regards,
andy
